verdict.rationale: Cubic is an AI code-review SaaS, so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence shows public source or an open license: the docs describe a hosted product with free trials, paid plans and SOC 2 compliance. A repository-root config file (cubic.yaml) and a 'community library' of review agents are adjacent features, not open source code for the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
